sloka: तत् श्रुता राघवेण उक्तम् वाक्यम् वाक्य विशारदः ।प्रति उवाच महातेजा विश्वमित्रो महामुनिः ॥१-४८-१४॥
transliteration: tat śrutā rāghaveṇa uktam vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ ।prati uvāca mahātejā viśvamitro mahāmuniḥ ॥1-48-14॥

translations.english: "O Descendant of the Raghus I shall tell all you about this hermitage cursed by the wrath of a great man.
